name: EmoEditor emotion predictor
preprocessing: RGB; PIL bilinear resize to 224x224; ToTensor to [0,1]; no ImageNet normalization
inference: float32 eval; softmax of the eight logits; frozen weights
status: Downloaded and hashed as .pt.download on Snellius; setup_emotion_model.py verifies and promotes it to .pt. Real inference and frame-cache validation pending.
limitations: Eight image-evoked emotion categories are proxy evidence; they are not the 21 audience reaction targets.
The checkpoint's alphabetical label order differs from the EmoSet repository's info.json order.
No neutral class exists; use an explicitly declared neutral VAD reference for peak scoring.
Softmax confidence is uncalibrated on Video2Reaction.
Keep checkpoint private on the cluster; it is not included in the repository or report bundle.
